question: We are choosing business internet for a 28-person office. Priorities: daytime video-call stability and reachable human support; ignore speed theater. Write a short research-style recommendation memo from the retrieved sources only. Candidates: PCCW, AT&T Business, SoftBank, China Telecom, NTT, Verizon Business, Singtel, China Mobile, China Unicom, HKBN. End with a numbered list of all ten from best to worst.

web_snippets.excerpt: A reseller notes Singtel installs quickly yet weekend outages linger unless you escalate twice.
NTT had the fewest daytime packet-loss tickets in a 40-office panel.
